$comment: Hand-maintained map from runtime source files to architecture clusters. The first matching rule wins. `npm run atlas` warns about every runtime file that no rule matches, so a new file forces a decision instead of disappearing from the map.

clusters.title: API server core
clusters.description: Hono app and server entry points, request context, tRPC procedure builders and the root router.

clusters.title: tRPC routers and HTTP sub-apps
clusters.description: One file per router mounted in api/router.ts, plus the SMS Hono sub-app mounted in api/boot.ts.

clusters.title: Authentication and sessions
clusters.description: Password hashing, JWT session creation, session validation and login brute-force protection.

clusters.title: Request security
clusters.description: Rate limiting, allowed origins, client IP resolution, ownership checks, upload signature checks, bot protection and security logging.

clusters.title: Platform services
clusters.description: Environment validation, Redis client and cache keys, system settings, business time zone helpers, scheduled-job locks and error logging.

clusters.title: Database schema and access
clusters.description: Drizzle schema, relations, storage classes and the MySQL connection pool.

clusters.title: Shared contracts
clusters.description: Types, limits and billing plans shared by the web app and the API.

clusters.title: Billing
clusters.description: Paymob hosted checkout and subscription grants.

clusters.title: Ledger aggregates
clusters.description: expense-rollups.ts and financial-month.ts.

clusters.title: Account lifecycle
clusters.description: user-purge-service.ts.

clusters.title: Scheduled job bodies
clusters.description: Job implementations scheduled from api/boot.ts.

clusters.title: Notifications
clusters.description: notification-engine.ts and firebase.ts.

clusters.title: WhatsApp
clusters.description: Baileys WhatsApp client and the in-process OTP state it verifies against.

clusters.title: Voice
clusters.description: voice-call-service.ts, voice-context-service.ts and api/services/voice-kernel/.

clusters.title: AI provider access
clusters.description: Provider clients, the provider registry, model name mapping, routing and fallback chains.

clusters.title: AI usage and cost governance
clusters.description: ai-usage-policy.ts, ai-cost-analytics.ts and ai-cost-policy.ts.

clusters.title: Arabic and Egyptian text processing
clusters.description: Normalizers, dictionaries, Arabic number parsing, negation detection, fuzzy matching and speech-to-text corrections.

clusters.title: Ingestion parsers
clusters.description: sms-ai-parser.ts, sms-rule-parser.ts, receipt-image-parser.ts and shortcut-generator.ts.

clusters.title: Classification benchmark helpers
clusters.description: benchmark-taxonomy-assert.ts, final-acceptance.ts and real-user-sim.ts, which live in api/lib.

clusters.title: Expense classification pipeline
clusters.description: smart-pipeline.ts and the modules it composes: rules, muscle memory, embeddings, taxonomy, confidence, decomposition and verification.

clusters.title: AI Center kernel
clusters.description: api/services/ai-kernel/ (intent-router, agent-planner, clarification-machine, context-packer, data-need-compiler, response-normalizer, retrieval-policy, capability-registry, ai-trace-logger).

clusters.title: AI action runtime
clusters.description: api/services/action-runtime/ (artifacts, extended-actions, goal-create).

clusters.title: AI memory
clusters.description: api/services/ai-memory/ (memory writer and retriever, embedding client and settings, vector stores).

clusters.title: Finance semantic layer
clusters.description: api/services/finance-semantic-layer/ (period resolver, row aggregators, resolvers, proactive insights, chart artifacts, cache).

clusters.title: Site guide
clusters.description: api/services/site-guide/ (knowledge base, embedding, retriever).

clusters.title: File storage
